subject: MCAS Results and Accountability
overview: The Medford School Committee received an extensive presentation on district MCAS and ACCESS data, approved a spring vacation camp, and established a timeline for revising committee rules.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Approved entering executive session to discuss contract negotiations with non-union personnel.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, which included bills, payroll, capital purchases, grants, field trips, meeting minutes, and a $2,000 PTO donation.

items.title: Mustang Moment
items.summary: Heard a musical presentation and student testimonies from the middle school select band program.

items.title: MCAS Results and Accountability
items.summary: Received a detailed presentation from academic directors regarding recent MCAS and English learner growth scores, alongside plans for implementing new analytical data tools and targeted learning interventions.

items.title: MAPS April Vacation Camp Approval
items.summary: Approved a proposal to run an April vacation camp at the Brooks School featuring a sliding scale fee structure.

items.title: Resolution 2026-6: School Committee Rules Review
items.summary: Approved a resolution establishing a timeline for committee members to submit and compile recommended amendments to the body's rules of order.

items.title: Condolences and Moments of Silence
items.summary: Expressed condolences to the families of former municipal employees Linda C. Magaldi Iacona and Mary Ann Cerrone Mahoney, followed by a moment of silence.
